sources: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy nightly video address, via Reuters Oct 27
fault_line: Turning the trick around: is Ukraine genuinely reversing Russian pipeline-infiltration tactics at Kupiansk, or is this a morale claim timed to the air-defence ask?

sections.what_happened: Zelenskyy said Kyiv's battlefield position is the strongest in some time in the 4.5-year war and could be strengthened with more Western air-defence deliveries. He cited, for the first time, Operation 'Veles' near Kupiansk (Kharkiv region, recaptured by Ukraine in late 2022, under constant Russian pressure since): Ukrainian fighters used underground gas pipelines to outflank Russian positions, turning a Russian tactic against them. He also cited an air assault operation in eastern Ukraine and Operation 'Vivaldi' further north, where a senior commander reported last month that the Third Army Corps cleared 75 sq km of Russian infiltration groups and recaptured 10 sq km, focused north of the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk fortress belt. Zelenskyy also referred to an August offensive further south returning 26 villages to Ukrainian control. No independent battlefield confirmation is offered in the Reuters piece and no Russian response is carried.
sections.what_verified: 1 declared-tier family: Reuters (T1) carrying Zelenskyy's own address. No second family in-window; Russian confirmation absent. Sig-2, so the sig>=3 two-family gate does not apply.
sections.what_disputed: Single-side battlefield claims with no geolocated or Russian-side confirmation in the piece; the 'Vivaldi' figures date to a commander's report last month, not a fresh verified advance. Russia's own Oct 27 line (via its human-rights commissioner) is that the Oleshky ceasefire is being fully upheld -- a different front, but it shows Moscow is not conceding battlefield reversals in its own messaging.
sections.why_matters: 'Ukraine says it turned Russia's own pipeline trick against it' -- Kupiansk 'Veles' as the hook, attributed throughout as Kyiv's claim, with the air-defence ask as the hidden motive.
